name: nsw-legislation
description: Verify NSW legislation identity, status and point-in-time versions against the official NSW legislation website.

interface.shortDescription: Verify NSW legislation and historical versions.
interface.longDescription: Checks NSW Acts, statutory instruments and environmental planning instruments against the official NSW legislation website. Identifies the title and applicable point-in-time version, records commencement and currency qualifications, confirms the applicable authorisation boundary, and fails closed when amendment or source issues remain unresolved.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this NSW legislation is in force and identify the official version.
